sources.name: ONS ASHE Table 1.7a, annual pay, gross, full-time employee jobs, UK, 2026 provisional
sources.note: The All Employees row: number of jobs, median, mean and the 10th to 90th percentiles.

sources.name: ONS ASHE Table 10.7a, annual pay, gross, full-time employee jobs by place of residence, parliamentary constituency, 2026 provisional
sources.note: The UK, Great Britain, England and Wales, England, the nine English regions, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland rows with their percentiles; every constituency row with its median and job count. Place of residence, not place of work. Suppressed estimates are null.

sources.name: ONS Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings time series of selected estimates, 1997 to 2026, Table 2 (full-time employees' pay, UK)
sources.note: The row Median gross annual earnings, All. Annual earnings begin in 1999. The ONS publishes 2004, 2006, 2011 and 2021 on two bases either side of a methodology or classification change; both columns are kept, labelled as the file labels them.

sources.name: ONS bulletin, Employee earnings in the UK: 2026

definitions.annual: Gross annual pay for the tax year that ended on 5 April 2026, for employees on adult rates who had been in the same job for more than a year.
definitions.fullTime: More than 30 paid hours a week, or 25 or more for the teaching professions.
definitions.sample: A 1% sample of employee jobs from HMRC PAYE records. The self-employed are not covered.
